title: Review of the sync engine
subject: Pull request #312: two-way sync with the cloud library
summary: Three reviewers read the change. One finding blocks the merge: a deleted photo can come back after a sync. The rest are small.

findings.title: A photo deleted on one machine comes back after a sync
findings.detail: When a photo is deleted on one machine and edited on another before they sync, the edit wins and the photo is restored. The deletion isn't kept as a record, so the merge can't tell a deletion from a photo it hasn't seen yet.
findings.proposal: Keep a deletion as a **tombstone** for 30 days, and let a deletion win over an older edit.

findings.title: The access token is written to the debug log
findings.detail: With debug logging on, each request is logged with its headers, the token among them.
findings.proposal: Leave the `authorization` header out of what's logged.

findings.title: A failed upload is retried at once, forever
findings.detail: Retry with a growing wait, and stop after five tries with a message.

needsYou.title: Decide whether #312 merges before the fix
needsYou.detail: The critical finding is behind a setting that's off by default. Merging now lets the rest be tried; waiting keeps main clean.

log.text: Correctness and security are done: one critical finding, one medium, one low (fixed) and a note.
